skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Terra & Traveller
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Terra & Traveller. Clothes Marcille wears when telling stories of her adventures aboard Rhodes Island. She acts as she imagines the Lunatic Magician would, summoning several familiars with a wave of her hand. Some of them even look like our operators!
skins.quote:
'Balanced Diet General Laios, Disciplined Lifestyle General Chilchuck, and Moderate Exercise General Senshi! Heed my command—Devour them!'
Marcille makes sure to practice her more dramatic lines before every performance.
